title: Brewing plastics: OCT reveals microplastic release from nylon tea bags in simulated brewed tea infusions
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,392-404
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00644A, Paper
Pramoda Maheshi Jayasekara, Praveen Abhishek, Bimsara Sandaruwan Kahandawala, Nisala Damith, Manura Weerasinghe, Nipun Shantha Kahatapitiya, Bhagya Nathali Silva, Shiromi Karunaratne, Ruchire Eranga Wijesinghe, Udaya Wijenayake, Anushka Upamali Rajapaksha, Meththika Vithanage
The integration of high-resolution optical coherence tomography with an image processing algorithm enables rapid detection and quantification of microplastics released from nylon tea bags, supporting accurate human exposure assessment.
